declare

 temp_warehouse_name varchar2(50);
begin
 :q_flag := 'N';
 IF NVL(length(:lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id), 0) = 13 THEN
 :unit_scheme := 'I';
 ELSE
 :unit_scheme := 'C';
 END IF;
 :ctrl_blk_1.product_no := 'N';

 /* Check whether unit is checked in */

 BEGIN
 SELECT coll_date, warehouse_id 
 INTO :lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date,temp_present_warehouse
 FROM units
 WHERE unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;

 WHEN others THEN
 null;
 END; 
 /* Check if the unit has any interdictions on it*/
 check_unit_interdictions;

/* Check whether components exist for the unit */
 
 BEGIN
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from components 
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and product_code != 'NONE';
 

 if temp_count <= 0 then
 /* Check whether unit exists in OPEN batch, same warehouse and not checked out */ 
 DECLARE
 temp_status varchar2(5); 
 temp_wh varchar2(20);
 BEGIN 
 select wtd.batch_id, wth.to_warehouse, wth.batch_status
 into :lab_wh_trans_dtl.batch_id, temp_to_warehouse, temp_status

 and receive_user is null ;

 BEGIN

 from vserv_master

 and code = substr(:batch_id,4,1)
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate);
 EXCEPTION 
 when others then
 null; 
 END;

 END IF; 
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 IF :global.warehouse = temp_present_warehouse THEN
 show_error('0234');
 ELSE 
 show_error('0232'); 
 :q_flag := 'Y';
 END IF;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 END ;
 IF :batch_id is not null THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT code_desc INTO temp_warehouse_name
 FROM vserv_master 
 WHERE code_type = 'LTYPE'
 AND code = temp_to_warehouse
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 IF temp_to_warehouse != :GLOBAL.warehouse THEN
 show_error('0235',temp_warehouse_name);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 :ctrl_blk_1.product_no := 'Y'; 
 set_item_property('lab_wh_trans_dtl.s_product_code', navigable, property_false);
 set_item_property('lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code', navigable, property_false);
 set_item_property('lab_wh_trans_dtl.aliquot', navigable, property_false);
 else
 /* Check whether any products to be checked in */
 /* begin
 
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from lab_wh_trans_dtl
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and receive_warehouse is null;
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('0249');
 check_package_failure;
 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; */
 :ctrl_blk_1.product_no := 'N';
 set_item_property('lab_wh_trans_dtl.s_product_code', navigable, property_true);
 set_item_property('lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code', navigable, property_true);
 set_item_property('lab_wh_trans_dtl.aliquot', navigable, property_true);
 
 end if;
 exception
 when others then

 end; 
 
 
 
end;

declare
 temp_to_warehouse varchar2(1);
 temp_x varchar2(1);
 temp_present_wh varchar2(1);
 temp_warehouse_name varchar2(50);
 temp_x varchar2(1); 
 temp_unit number;
 temp_present_warehouse varchar2(1);
 n_rem number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :q_flag := 'N';
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from lab_wh_trans_dtl
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code and
 aliquot = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.aliquot
 and receive_warehouse is null;
 exception
 when no_data_found then 
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from components
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id and

 product_code = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code and
 component_prefix = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.aliquot
 and component_status = 'L';
 
 exception

 when others then

 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 
 when OTHERS then

 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :aliquot_yes := 'N';
 begin
 select warehouse_id into temp_present_warehouse
 from components
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code and
 component_prefix = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.aliquot
 and component_status = 'L';
 exception
 when no_data_found then

 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then

 end;
 DECLARE
 temp_status varchar2(5); 
 temp_wh varchar2(20);
 BEGIN 
 select wtd.batch_id, wth.to_warehouse, wth.batch_status
 into :batch_id, temp_to_warehouse, temp_status
 from lab_wh_trans_dtl wtd, lab_wh_trans_hdr wth
 where unit_id = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.unit_id
 and wth.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and wtd.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and wtd.batch_id = wth.batch_id
 and product_code = :product_code
 and aliquot = :aliquot
 and receive_date is null
 and receive_user is null 
 and rownum < 2; --tmpp
 IF temp_status = 'OPEN' THEN
 BEGIN
 
 select substr(code_desc,1,20) into temp_wh
 from vserv_master 
 where code_type = 'LTYPE'
 and code = substr(:batch_id,4,1)
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate)
 and rownum < 2; --tmpp
 EXCEPTION 
 when others then
 null; 
 END;
 show_error('0233',' Batch ' || :lab_wh_trans_dtl.batch_id || ' is open' ||' at ' || temp_wh );
 END IF; 
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 IF :global.warehouse = temp_present_warehouse THEN
 show_error('0234');
 ELSE 
 show_error('0232'); 
 :q_flag := 'Y';
 END IF;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 END ;
 IF :batch_id is not null THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT code_desc INTO temp_warehouse_name
 FROM vserv_master 
 WHERE code_type = 'LTYPE'
 AND code = temp_to_warehouse
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 IF temp_to_warehouse != :GLOBAL.warehouse THEN
 show_error('0235',temp_warehouse_name);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 /* Check whether there any aliquots pending for codabar units
 If there are any, show a warning saying Interdiction will not be removed
 */
 BEGIN
 SELECT count(*) 
 INTO n_rem
 FROM lab_wh_trans_dtl
 WHERE unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id
 and product_code = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code
 and aliquot != :lab_wh_trans_dtl.aliquot
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and receive_user is NULL
 and receive_date is NULL ;
 IF n_rem > 0 THEN
 show_error('0236');
 :aliquot_yes := 'Y';
 END IF ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END; 
EXCEPTION 
 WHEN form_trigger_failure THEN
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 WHEN others THEN
 message('Contact I.S. ' || sqlerrm);
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_TEMPRATURE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_temprature IS
 temp_min_temp number(5,2);
 temp_max_temp number(5,2);
BEGIN
 :ctrl_blk_1.inter_yes := 'N';
 begin
 select max_rcv_temp, min_rcv_temp
 into temp_max_temp, temp_min_temp
 from valid_products
 where product_code = substr(:lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code,1,5)
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.s_checkin_temp not
 between temp_min_temp and temp_max_temp
 THEN
 show_error('4100');
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :global.x
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id
 and product_code = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and inter_code = 'CMT';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :ctrl_blk_1.inter_yes := 'Y'; 
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 END IF;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 -- message('Error in selecting from valid_products');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_SAVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DO_SAVE IS
 temp_user varchar2(6);
 abc number(2);
 temp_return_val VARCHAR2(1);
 n_rem number;
 v_local_time date;
 v_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 -- time zone change --5/8/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, to_date(to_char(sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'), 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'), v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'), 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'), 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.inter_yes = 'Y' then
 show_error('9789','CMT');
 temp_return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id,
 :lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code,
 'CMT',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);

 if temp_return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions CMT not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
/* Check whether any products defined for the unit, if there is not place the interdiction 
 on unit interdictions, else component_interdictions */
 if :ctrl_blk_1.product_no = 'Y' then
 /* Update lab wh trans dtl table for the unit */
 IF :batch_id is not null THEN
 begin
 UPDATE lab_wh_trans_dtl
 SET receive_user = :banner.user_id,
 --receive_date = trunc(sysdate), -- Commented by Kishore on 06/08/2012. IM 8731
 receive_date = trunc(v_sysdate), -- Added by Kishore on 06/08/2012. IM 8731
 receive_warehouse = :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 receive_temp = :ctrl_blk_1.s_checkin_temp
 WHERE unit_id = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and batch_id = :LAB_wh_trans_dtl.batch_id ;
 exception 
 when others then
 message('WH_TRANS_DTL..'||sqlerrm);
 handle_error;
 end;
 END IF;
 
 else
 IF :batch_id is not null THEN
 begin
 UPDATE lab_wh_trans_dtl
 SET receive_user = :banner.user_id,
 --receive_date = trunc(sysdate), -- Commented by Kishore on 06/08/2012. IM 8731
 receive_date = trunc(v_sysdate), -- Added by Kishore on 06/08/2012. IM 8731
 receive_warehouse = :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 receive_temp = :ctrl_blk_1.s_checkin_temp
 WHERE unit_id = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and product_code = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.product_code
 and aliquot = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.aliquot
 and batch_id = :LAB_wh_trans_dtl.batch_id ;
 exception 
 when others then
 message('WH_TRANS_DTL..'||sqlerrm);
 handle_error;
 end;
 end if;
 
 end if;
/* if every unit in the batch is checked in update the status to 'RECON' */
 if :batch_id is not null then
 BEGIN
 SELECT count(*) INTO n_rem
 FROM lab_wh_trans_dtl
 WHERE batch_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.batch_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and receive_user is NULL
 and receive_date is NULL ;
 IF n_rem = 0 THEN 
 
 UPDATE lab_wh_trans_hdr
 SET recon_user = :banner.user_id,
 recon_date = trunc(v_sysdate) ,
 batch_status = 'RECON'
 WHERE batch_id = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.batch_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id ;
 END IF ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 message('wh_trans_hdr..'|| sqlerrm);
 handle_error;
 END; 
end if;

update_units_components;
 if :q_flag = 'Y' then
 insert_hdr_dtl_nitb;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit_form; 
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := '';
 IF not form_success THEN
 message('Error in COMMIT ... Contact IS.');
 :system.message_level := 0;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 next_record;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 show_error('8010');
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_UNITS_COMPONENTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE update_units_components IS
BEGIN
/* Update Units table , delete Transit Interdiction for the unit if there are
 no components, else update components table, delete Transit Interdiction
 for the component */
 if :ctrl_blk_1.product_no = 'Y' then
 begin
 update units
 set warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse
 where unit_id = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in Updating Units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.unit_id
 and coll_date = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and inter_code = 'INTR';
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in deleting from Unit Interdictions'); 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :q_flag = 'Y' then
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id
 and coll_date = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and inter_code = 'NITB';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 insert into unit_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, 
 inter_code, insert_dats, inter_user_id,
 program_id) 
 values 
 (:lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id, :lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id, 'NITB', sysdate, :banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in inserting Unit interdiction');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if; 
 
 else
 begin
 update components
 set warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse
 where unit_id = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.unit_id
 and product_code = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.product_code
 and component_prefix = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.aliquot
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in updating Components');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :aliquot_yes = 'N' then
 begin
 delete from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.unit_id
 and coll_date = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.coll_date
 and product_code = :LAB_WH_TRANS_DTL.product_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and inter_code = 'INTR';
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in deleting from Component Interdictions');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if :q_flag = 'Y' then
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id
 and coll_date = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and product_code = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code
 and inter_code = 'NITB' ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 insert into component_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, product_code,
 inter_code, insert_dats, inter_user_id,
 program_id) 
 values 
 (:lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id, :lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code,
 'NITB', sysdate, :banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in inserting Component interdiction');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if; 
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GEN_WH_BATCH_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GEN_WH_BATCH_ID RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 temp_max_num number(6);
 temp_ret_num varchar2(10); 
BEGIN
 SELECT nvl(max_number,0) + 1
 INTO temp_max_num
 FROM number_generation
 WHERE chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 AND number_type = 'LAB_WH_BATCH'
 FOR update of max_number;

 temp_ret_num := 'LWN' || :GLOBAL.warehouse || 
 lpad(to_char(temp_max_num),6,'0');

 UPDATE number_generation 
 SET max_number = temp_max_num
 WHERE chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 AND number_type = 'LAB_WH_BATCH';

 return temp_ret_num;
RETURN NULL; EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 message('Number generation error ... Contact IS');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
RETURN NULL; END;

PROCEDURE check_unit_interdictions IS
 temp_count number;
 /* Check if the unit has any interdictions on it*/
 BEGIN
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id and
 -- and coll_date = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and inter_code in (select inter_code from valid_interdictions_lab
 where inter_type in ('B', 'H', 'N')
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)
 and system_inter_code != 'INTR'); 
 exception
 when others then
 message(sqlerrm);pause;
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_count > 0 then
 show_error('1000');
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure; 
 END;
